cases.question: Was the revenue increase from Q1 to Q2 caused by acquiring more customers?
human_review: Customer acquisition cannot be established from aggregate financial data.
Identify missing customer count, volume, or pricing evidence; no invented cause.

cases.question: Did higher supplier prices cause the Q1-to-Q2 profit decline?
human_review: Separate the accounting COGS contribution from unproven supplier-price causation.
Ask for unit prices, purchasing volumes, or product mix; no invented business cause.

split_note: Previously inspected regression tasks; not an untouched holdout.
retry_policy: No automatic retry of a started attempt.
